cues: Lift one foot an inch off the floor and hold, the body still.
Push the floor away and stay long, like a plank of wood.
Nothing moves but the part named.

faults.fix: Push the floor away and stay long, like a plank of wood.
Move slower and smaller until the rest stays still.
